summary: Created and restart-verified the local administrator account opsadmin on node1.
actions_performed: Generated and applied a credential entirely on node1 without exposing it.
Set home ownership to opsadmin:opsadmin and permissions to 0700.
Added opsadmin to wheel and granted unrestricted passwordless sudo privileges.
Safely restarted node1 and verified account persistence and administrative access afterward.

evidence.summary: Post-restart proof shows local passwd, group, and shadow entries; opsadmin is a wheel member with an enabled credential.
Before and after restart, /home/opsadmin is owned by opsadmin:opsadmin with mode 700, is writable by opsadmin, and denies another user access.
Before and after restart, opsadmin successfully executed through sudo as effective UID 0; the validated policy permits all commands as all users.

Healthy baseline boot ID c668794c-98ce-4523-80e1-547c8e105cbd was captured, restart acknowledged, and command availability returned with changed boot ID 97aa14b6-08bf-400c-8c85-2d4777cf7bc3. Account, credential state, home privacy, wheel membership, and root sudo access all recovered.
